title: Automatic brightness for keyboard (enable while typing, adjust with ambiend light sensor)
line: The keyboard backlight can now turn off by itself when you stop typing, and in bright light on laptops with a light sensor.
explanation: Power management could only set a fixed keyboard backlight level per power profile; nothing turned it off while the keyboard wasn't used, and the ambient light sensor was ignored for the keyboard. The first commit adds a per-profile "Turn off keyboard backlight" idle timeout (Never by default, 5 s to 5 min or custom): the backlight goes off after that much inactivity and comes back at its previous level on the next input. The second commit adds a "Turn off keyboard backlight in bright light" checkbox, shown only when iio-sensor-proxy reports a light sensor: while it's on, powerdevil claims the sensor like KWin does for automatic screen brightness, turns the backlight off above 300 lux and back on below 150 lux, and ignores changes that last under 2 seconds, like KWin.

commits.message:
daemon, kcm: turn off keyboard backlight when idle

The keyboard backlight stayed on at its level even while the keyboard
was not used. Power profiles can now turn it off after a chosen idle
time, and it comes back at its previous level on the next input.

BUG: 516629

media.caption: Before: Power Management only offers a fixed keyboard brightness per profile.
After: new "Turn off keyboard backlight" idle timeout and, with a light sensor, a bright-light checkbox.
After: idle timeout choices for the keyboard backlight.
After: without a running light sensor service, the bright-light checkbox is hidden (and the service isn't started to check).
